name: Quick Backup
description: Backup important files to a specified directory
script:
import shutil
import os
from datetime import datetime

backup_dir = f'C:/Backups/backup_{datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")}'
os.makedirs(backup_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Add your important directories here
sources = ['C:/Users/Documents', 'C:/Projects']

for src in sources:
    if os.path.exists(src):
        dest = os.path.join(backup_dir, os.path.basename(src))
        shutil.copytree(src, dest)
        print(f'Backed up {src} to {dest}')

print(f'Backup complete: {backup_dir}')
